regimens.dose_text: Start 0.25 mg PO 3 times daily (0.75 mg/day); titrate weekly: Week 2: 0.5 mg TID; Week 3: 0.75 mg TID; Week 4: 1 mg TID. After Week 4, increase by 1.5 mg/day weekly up to 9 mg/day, then by up to 3 mg/day weekly up to max 24 mg/day (8 mg TID). Discontinue gradually over 7 days.

There are no adequate data on the developmental risk associated with the use of ropinirole in pregnant women. In animal studies, ropinirole had adverse effects on development when administered to pregnant rats at doses similar to (neurobehavioral impairment) or greater than (teratogenicity and embryolethality at >36 times) the MRHD for Parkinson’s disease.

tier.note: No adequate human pregnancy data; animal studies showed neurobehavioral impairment at clinical-range doses, teratogenicity/embryolethality at >36x MRHD with maternal toxicity, and potentiation of L-dopa teratogenicity in rabbits.
